scope: Two BLASes were built on the same desktop adapter with compaction allowed. Xbox slot 119 cloned the first and compacted the second. A subsequent desktop TLAS and inline ray query checked both instances. Misaligned clone and visualization decode reported E_INVALIDARG and E_NOTIMPL respectively at list Close. Xbox serialized payloads require separate decoding.

retail.subsequent_fault: FD3D12RayTracingPipelineCache::GetOrCompileShader dereferenced the null Xbox Device8 interface before calling slot 115. The unmodified-settings run exited before the first presentation.
retail.state_object_identity: The earlier reference trace in retail-shaders.json matched its first slot 115 input to global/1280. The new run stopped before passing its input to that method.
